checks.message: APP_ENV is unset.
checks.remediation: Run the launch gate with APP_ENV=production.

checks.message: DATABASE_URL is missing or not Postgres.
checks.remediation: Set DATABASE_URL to the production Postgres pooled URL.

checks.message: BETTER_AUTH_URL is missing, non-HTTPS, localhost, or a placeholder.
checks.remediation: Set BETTER_AUTH_URL to the public production origin, for example https://ourdream.ai.

checks.message: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET is missing, short, or still the development placeholder.
checks.remediation: Generate a unique production BETTER_AUTH_SECRET with at least 32 characters.

checks.message: Internal API token is missing or invalid.
checks.remediation: Set INTERNAL_TOKEN to a production-only secret.

checks.message: Cron secret is missing or invalid.
checks.remediation: Set CRON_SECRET to a production-only secret distinct from INTERNAL_TOKEN.

checks.message: Internal and cron tokens are missing or identical.
checks.remediation: Use separate random secrets for INTERNAL_TOKEN and CRON_SECRET.

checks.message: Web surface probe evidence is missing or invalid: WEB_SURFACE_PROBE_REPORT is not set; MAIN_WEB_URL or BETTER_AUTH_URL is missing or invalid; ADMIN_WEB_URL is missing or invalid; no probe report was loaded.
checks.remediation: Run `bun run --filter @idream/main probe:web-surface -- --report .tmp/launch-web-surface-probe.json` against the deployed main/admin web surfaces, then set WEB_SURFACE_PROBE_REPORT before check:launch.

checks.message: Redis URL is missing or invalid.
checks.remediation: Set REDIS_URL to the production queue Redis instance.

checks.message: BULLMQ_PREFIX is missing or still a service-local development default.
checks.remediation: Set one shared production BULLMQ_PREFIX, such as idream:prod, for main-web, chat, and gen workers.

checks.message: CHAT_PROVIDER is still mock.
checks.remediation: Configure a production CHAT_PROVIDER adapter and credentials before launch.

checks.remediation: Configure a production IMAGE_PROVIDER adapter and credentials before launch.

checks.message: Chat service URL is missing or invalid.
checks.remediation: Deploy packages/chat and set CHAT_SERVICE_URL.

checks.message: CHAT_DATABASE_URL is missing, not Postgres, or not using the chat_service role.
checks.remediation: Set CHAT_DATABASE_URL to the production Postgres URL for the chat_service role; do not reuse main-web DATABASE_URL.

checks.message: Chat Redis URL is missing or invalid.
checks.remediation: Set CHAT_REDIS_URL or shared REDIS_URL so packages/chat uses the production queue Redis instance.

checks.message: CHAT_FS_ROOT is missing or not an absolute durable-storage path.
checks.remediation: Set CHAT_FS_ROOT to an absolute path mounted on durable storage for chat logs and memories.

checks.message: Chat model provider is mock.
checks.remediation: Set CHAT_MODEL_PROVIDER=pipeline or openai for packages/chat; mock is not production-ready.

checks.message: Chat model base URL is missing or invalid.
checks.remediation: Set CHAT_MODEL_BASE_URL or PIPELINE_API_URL to the production OpenAI-compatible chat gateway.

checks.message: Chat model API key is missing or invalid.
checks.remediation: Set CHAT_MODEL_API_KEY or PIPELINE_API_TOKEN so packages/chat can authenticate to the chat gateway.

checks.message: Chat service probe evidence is missing or invalid: CHAT_SERVICE_PROBE_REPORT is not set; no probe report was loaded.
checks.remediation: Run `bun run --filter @idream/main probe:chat-service -- --report .tmp/launch-chat-service-probe.json` against the real chat service, then set CHAT_SERVICE_PROBE_REPORT before check:launch.

checks.message: Chat model probe evidence is missing or invalid: CHAT_MODEL_PROBE_REPORT is not set; no probe report was loaded.
checks.remediation: Run `bun run --filter @idream/main probe:chat -- --report .tmp/launch-chat-probe.json` against the real chat model gateway, then set CHAT_MODEL_PROBE_REPORT before check:launch.
